preset.name: linux-clang-gpu
preset.comment: Linux clang PhysX general settings (GPU, shared libraries)

cmakeSwitch.name: PX_BUILDSNIPPETS
cmakeSwitch.comment: Disable snippets: they need OpenGL/X11, absent from the headless runner. Snippets are samples and are never shipped, so this does not change the published artifact.

cmakeSwitch.name: PX_GENERATE_GPU_PROJECTS_ONLY
cmakeSwitch.comment: Generate both CPU and GPU projects

cmakeSwitch.name: PX_GENERATE_GPU_REDUCED_ARCHITECTURES
cmakeSwitch.comment: Generate a single CUDA arch + PTX fallback. Required on GitHub runners (16 GB RAM) — the full arch set OOM-crashes ptxas under parallel nvcc. PTX JIT covers any sm_70+ GPU at first run.

cmakeSwitch.name: PX_GENERATE_GPU_STATIC_LIBRARIES
cmakeSwitch.comment: Generate PhysXGpu as a shared library

cmakeParam.name: CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX
cmakeParam.comment: Install path relative to PhysX SDK root
